newsitem.title: USA: HP, VeriFone form Internet alliance.
newsitem.headline: HP, VeriFone form Internet alliance.

text.p: Computer industry giant Hewlett-Packard Co and VeriFone Inc, a maker of products for sales verification, on Tuesday announced plans to market, sell and provide a range payment products for Internet shopping.
The products will be based on a standard known as the Visa/MasterCard Secure Electronic Transaction (SET) protocol.

Under the alliance, they plan to jointly participate in the Visa/MasterCard worldwide SET trials, jointly develop and deliver products for financial institutions worldwide and jointly deliver product packages tailored for merchants.
"We believe this can greatly accelerate Internet-commerce applications," Roger Bertman, vice president and general manager of VeriFone's Internet Commerce Division, said in a statement.

"We will have the capability to offer financial institutions and merchants worldwide more secure and complete Internet-payment solutions including hardware, software and integration and support services," he added.

Key components of the alliance would include Hewlett-Packard server computers and security products, VeriFone payment processors and merchant software. The two also will provide systems integration and support services.
